sections.title: Вердикт и происхождение
sections.text: RED для кандидата 89c858ecd (HEAD после P11.14); база a2e89b866 (коммит перед первым коммитом P11.1). Один независимый read-only проход Grok 4.7, session 01a13375-ee35-7b02-8a1d-07e01a8943b9, без субагентов (вызовов spawn_subagent нет). Маршрут grok-4.7/xhigh подтверждён событием init потока (model=grok-4.7), argv (--effort xhigh) и нативным summary.json сессии (current_model_id=grok-4.7, reasoning_effort=xhigh); CLI exit 0, result success, 61 turn. Запуск — verb launch моста planner-orch, бриф artifacts/P11.15/review-brief.md; широкие проверки P11.14 не повторялись. Владелец запросил «аудит на grok 4.7». Исправления — одна коррекция у владельцев находок после вердикта; вердикт ревьюера сохранён дословно.

sections.title: Независимый отчёт
sections.text:
VERDICT: RED

## Findings

**F1 medium, P11.6, `packages/harness/configs/claude-code/hooks/auto-approve/lib/safedirs.py:99`**

Hook and CLI registry readers open only `~/.swissknifeman/projects.json` and `~/.swissknifeman/topology.json`. After `save_db` / `save_topology` the owner files exist and the legacy files do not:

- projects: `/tmp/tmp.2FdkgogoF1/.local/state/swissknifeman/skiller/projects.json`
- topology: `/tmp/tmp.2FdkgogoF1/.local/state/swissknifeman/maind/topology.json`

`load_allowlist` on a valid `<config>/harness/safe-dirs.json` with `include_registered_projects: true` and `dirs: []` returned `ALLOW_ROOTS []`, `PROJECT_COVERED False`, `RM_IN_REGISTERED_PROJECT_IS_SAFE False`. `harness safe-dirs prune-ask --all-projects` printed `ask-rules rm not found - pure` (it reads `packages/harness/lib/harness/safedirs.py:192`). The memory hook (`packages/harness/configs/claude-code/hooks/memory/lib/common.sh:68`) set `MEM_TOPO` and `MEM_PROJDB` to the legacy paths, `topo_node_path brain` was empty, and `resolve_member_path demo` printed `demo`. Copying the same records to the legacy files made the project covered, `rm` safe, `topo_node_path brain` equal to `/tmp/tmp.2FdkgogoF1/vault/brain`, and `resolve_member_path demo` equal to `/tmp/tmp.2FdkgogoF1/work/demo`. No warning was printed. `cmd_init` still names that legacy registry (`packages/harness/lib/harness/safedirs.py:108`). `docs/architecture/ecosystem.md:261` says this move is done and that the legacy files are read with a warning.

The list stays fail-closed: `rm` in the registered project is denied. A new install, which no longer creates the legacy files, never contributes onboarded projects to the allowlist, and the memory hook resolves members to a bare name.

Expected: the same active file as `skiller` `Env.db_file` and `maind` `Env.topology_file` (new file when it exists, otherwise the legacy file, with one warning).

**F2 low, P11.6, `packages/skiller/install.sh:125`**

The installer prompt is gated on `[[ ! -f "$HOME/.swissknifeman/topology.json" ]]`. With the new topology file present and the legacy file absent, that test is true (`INSTALL_CONDITION_WOULD_PROMPT yes`). `install.sh` was not executed.

Expected: the prompt uses the same path as `maind` `Env.topology_file`.

**F3 low, P11.9, `packages/harness/lib/harness/safedirs.py:272`**

`harness safe-dirs` with no arguments prints `init create ~/.swissknifeman/safe-dirs.json`. `new_state_file()` in that same home is `/tmp/tmp.2FdkgogoF1/.config/swissknifeman/harness/safe-dirs.json`, which is the file the ladder writes when none exists.

Expected: the help names `<config>/harness/safe-dirs.json`, and names the legacy file only as the existing active source.

**F4 medium, P11.13, `docs/core/index.md:40`**

The core tombstone still tells the reader to run:

`PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s core/tests`

That command exits 1:

`ImportError: Start directory is not importable: 'core/tests'`

The comment on that line says the shim and the modules are still in core. `core/` is absent.

Expected: the development block points only at `bash packages/aicore/scripts/test.sh`.

**F5 medium, P11.6, `bootstrap/skills/package-architecture/SKILL.md:116`**

The canonical package skill says topology is implemented by `lib/skiller/topology.py`, stored at `~/.swissknifeman/topology.json`, and saved with a `.bak` backup. `packages/skiller/lib/skiller/topology.py` is absent (`topology.py ABSENT`). `maind.topology.save_topology` writes `<state>/maind/topology.json` through `aicore.state.backup`. The same skill at line 96, and `packages/skiller/docs/guide/cli.md:214`, still present `~/.swissknifeman/projects.json` as the current project map. The same stale path is the current location in `packages/skiller/README.md:96`, `SECURITY.md:53`, `docs/guide/installation.md:161`, `docs/guide/troubleshooting.md:4`, and `docs/guide/integration-checklist.md:103`. `cli.md:170` already documents the `maind topology` alias.

Expected: the skill and those guides name `<state>/skiller/projects.json` and `<state>/maind/topology.json`, with the legacy files as a warned fallback.

**F6 low, P11.13, `docs/reference.md:33`**

The live "Taken" cells name `core.provider.distribution` and `core.provider.projection`. The same claim is the present tense in `docs/reference/provider-distribution.md:4`, `docs/reference/provider-projection.md:5`, and the `_doc` strings of `packages/aicore/configs/provider-distribution.json:3` and `provider-projection.json:3`.

`PYTHONPATH=packages/aicore/lib:. python3 -c 'import core.provider.distribution'` exits 1 with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'core'`. `import aicore.provider.distribution` loads `packages/aicore/lib/aicore/provider/distribution.py`.

Expected: those sentences name `aicore.provider.distribution` and `aicore.provider.projection`.

## Checked, holds

- `core/` and `packages/artifex` are absent. `python3 scripts/ecosystem-units.py check --strict` exits 0. `python3 scripts/public-hygiene.py` reports 0 violations.
- No `(3, 8)` under `packages/**/*.py`. The maind, analyst, harness, and skiller doctors import `aicore.MIN_PYTHON`.
- `provides.doctor` on maind, analyst, and harness `unit.json` is `check-result/v1`. maind declares `urn:swissknifeman:maind:mcp-tools` at `schemas/mcp-tools/v1`.
- With no legacy file, skiller and maind write the new state paths and leave `~/.swissknifeman/{projects,topology}.json` absent.
- The safe-dirs ladder loads `<config>/harness/safe-dirs.json`. An allowlist with no roots does not mark `rm` safe. `load_allowlist` returns `None` for an unreadable or invalid document (`safedirs.py:72`).
- The memory hook reads `.swissknifeman/hooks.env` before `memory.env.ini` (`common.sh:26`).
- `maind health --plan-repair` returns before `apply_repair` (`health.py:576`). The deep round-trip stores a fact only when a memory daemon answers (`health.py:188`). That combination was not executed.

Module suites, golden files, doctor filesystem snapshots, and the MCP and analyst event commands were not re-run.

FINDINGS: 6

sections.title: Адресное исполнение
sections.text: Одна коррекция у владельцев, затем повторное ревью только находок и изменённого замыкания, без повторного аудита фазы. P11.6: F1 (safedirs.py:99 и memory hook common.sh:68 читают только наследные projects.json/topology.json — читать активный файл skiller Env.db_file / maind Env.topology_file с одним предупреждением при наследном), F2 (skiller install.sh:125 — тот же путь топологии), F5 (bootstrap/skills/package-architecture/SKILL.md:116, packages/skiller/docs и README с путями projects.json/topology.json и несуществующим lib/skiller/topology.py — через канон и генератор). P11.9: F3 (harness safe-dirs help, safedirs.py:272 — назвать <config>/harness/safe-dirs.json). P11.13: F4 (docs/core/index.md:40 — убрать команду discover -s core/tests), F6 (docs/reference.md:33 и provider-distribution/projection docs, _doc конфигов — aicore.provider.*). Корректировка проекций и lock — через источник и генератор, затем golden check.
